Al Manzel Al Mubarak Finance from anb

We offers a wide range of real estate financing products that contribute and meet our client’s needs with competitive advantages and affordable procedures, and because you, our dear client, are the priority for our attention, we would like to offer you whatever supports the realization of your dreams through

Housing Unit Under Construction Financing Program

 

A real estate financing compliant with the provisions of the Islamic Sharia for a housing unit under construction, which is released in several installments by transferring directly to the real estate developer’s account according to the construction stages. The profits of each batch shall be deducted during the construction period only, and upon completion of the construction of the unit, the full installment (principal and profit together) shall be deducted.
Financing benefits:

A finance up to SAR 5,000,000.
The repayment in fixed and affordable installments for a period of 30 years
Less profit calculated on the entire financing.
Exempting the heirs from repaying the remaining installments in case of death, “God forbid”.
Sharia-Compliant financing.

Home Loan

We make it facilitated for you to fulfill your wish to own the property you have always dreamed of

Financing Benefits:

Financing programs to purchase all types of residential properties (land, apartment, villa, townhouse, residential building).
A finance up to SAR 5,000,000.
The repayment in fixed and affordable installments for a period of 30 years.
Selecting the property you wish to own and in all areas.
The finance is granted to all workers in the government, military and private sectors and retirees.
Exempting the heirs from repaying the remaining installments in case of death, “God forbid”.
Sharia-Compliant financing.
Ready Units Purchase Product for Non-Saudi:

Benefits:
The customer has the freedom to choose the property that suits their needs.
Financing period up to 20 years.
Fixed competitive profit margin
Available for premium residency holders, GCC nationals, and regular residency holders.
Compliant with Islamic Sharia principles.
 
Off-Plan– Cash to Financing:
It is an innovative real estate product that allows customers who started their plan with the developer through cash payments to complete the remaining value of the property unit through the bank.

Benefits:
Flexible payment plan during the construction period
Easy and fast procedures
Comprehensive financing insurance
Financing up to SAR 5 million
Competitive deduction rate up to 75%, giving you higher financing.
The product is available for Saudi's, Premium Residency holders and GCC citizens
 
Real Estate Refinancing Product:
The real estate refinancing product is considered one of the most important programs for retaining customers, where customers are granted cash liquidity in exchange for re-mortgaging the land / apartment / villa / residential building owned by the customer, according to the conditions and credit policies of this product.

Benefits:
Maximum financing amount of 5 million.
Financing period up to 30 years.
Compliant with Islamic Sharia principles.
Competitive profit margins.
 
Balance Transfer Product
ANB aims to provide housing finance products to its valued customers and enable balance transfer through the bank. In order to expand the segment of beneficiaries from housing finance, the bank designed this product in compliance with Islamic Sharia principles under the Murabaha structure.
Benefits:
Up to 3 lands or 3 apartments can be purchased under the same financing according to the customer’s financial eligibility.
Providing both REDF and Non-REDF customers
Compliant with Islamic Sharia principles.
 
Real Estate-Guaranteed Finance

The finance guaranteed by the property you own is an easy and affordable way to obtain the cash you need
Financing Benefits:

Real estate-guaranteed financing programs for all types of residential properties (land, apartment, villa, townhouse, residential building).
A finance up to SAR 5,000,000.
The repayment in fixed and affordable installments for a period of 30 years.
Mortgaging the property you want, provided that the client shall be the owner of the property.
The finance is granted to all workers in the government, military and private sectors and retirees.
Exempting the heirs from repaying the remaining installments in case of death, “God forbid”.
Sharia-Compliant financing.
Real Estate Financing + Personal Financing

Obtain the real estate financing to purchase your dream home, in addition to a sufficient personal financing to meet your requirements and fulfill your other obligations.
Financing Benefits:

The finance is granted to all workers in the government, military and private sectors, bank employees and retirees.
Sharia-Compliant financing.
Self-Construction Financing

anb provides self-construction financing with real estate guarantee as one of the real estate financing solutions that are compatible with the provisions of the Islamic Sharia, with easy and affordable procedures, in order to enable you to build your home as you desire and in a manner that suits you. The Self-Construction Financing is granted to the client guaranteed by the land owned by him in several batches to be disbursed at each construction stage as per a specific schedule and according to the completion stages.
Financing Benefits:

A finance up to SAR 3,000,000.
The repayment in fixed and affordable installments for a period of 30 years.
The finance is granted to all workers in the government, military and private sectors and retirees.
Exempting the heirs from repaying the remaining installments in case of death, “God forbid”.
Sharia-Compliant financing.
Granting the finance in several batches according to the construction stages.
Land and Loan Financing

anb provides a land and loan product in cooperation with the Ministry of Municipal, Rural Affairs and Housing and Real Estate Development Fund. In case the beneficiary obtains the land as a support from the Ministry of Housing, he can obtain financing to build the land from the anb
Financing benefits:

The repayment in fixed and affordable installments for a period of 30 years.
The finance is granted to all workers in the government, military and private sectors and retirees.
Exempting the heirs from repaying the remaining installments in case of death, “God forbid”.
Sharia-Compliant financing.
Granting the finance in several batches according to the construction stages.
Real Estate Financing Program

anb provides, in cooperation with the Ministry of Municipal, Rural Affairs and Housing and Real Estate Development Fund, a real estate financing to the citizens who have been approved in the real estate loan program by the Ministry of Municipal, Rural Affairs and Housing and Real Estate Development Fund to purchase or mortgage the property they want with facilitated procedures, after the citizen is awarded by the Ministry of Municipal, Rural Affairs and Housing and Real Estate Development Fund, and having fulfilled the anb standards applicable to him and the property, the citizen is granted the real estate loan program from the Bank, and the Bank supports the financing profits on its behalf, wholly or partially, for a financing amount no more than SAR 500,000, as determined based on the number of family members and income level (monthly).
Financing benefits:

The repayment in fixed and affordable installments for a period of 30 years.
The finance is granted to all workers in the government, military and private sectors and retirees.
Free choice of any of the mortgage program options (ready housing unit, housing unit under construction, mortgage, self-construction, land and loan).
Free choice of any of the financing solutions (down payment reduction service, flexible installment). 
Exempting the heirs from repaying the remaining installments in case of death, “God forbid”.
Sharia-Compliant financing.
